newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-NatMutual says institutional bidding strong.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-NatMutual says institutional bidding strong.

text.p: Australian life office National Mutual Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday that institutional demand for its stock market offering was strong and this indicated that the institutional component would be over-subscribed.
"First day bids were very strong. At current levels the volume of bids is significantly in excess of the 280 million shares available for institutional bidding," it said.
"Demand is well balanced and spread almost evenly between Australian and overseas investors."
The life office is 51 percent owned by French insurer AXA SA.
The institutional offer opened on Wednesday and will close on Friday. Institutions were given an indicative bidding range of between A$1.35 and A$1.55 per share.
National Mutual said details of the final issue price and the final allocation of shares will be announced either on Sunday or Monday.
